repos.name: backnotprop/plannotator
repos.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
repos.readme_excerpt:
⭐️ NEW: Plannotator Inbox is the missing review layer between you and multi-agent work. It surfaces decisions, prototypes, variations, plans, and everything you need to stay in the loop. Works with all coding agents and personal assistants.

Plannotator is a local, browser-based review surface for AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Kiro, Droid, Amp, DeepSeek Harness, and Pi. Plannotator Inbox also works with personal assistants (Grok Bot, Muse, Hermes, OpenClaw).

repos.name: vercel-labs/agent-browser
repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.readme_excerpt:
Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell.

agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. snapshot returns the page as compact text with a ref such as @e1 for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call.

repos.name: google/elephant-goldfish-model
repos.description: Open-source plugin for designing and reviewing software with agents
repos.readme_excerpt:
Develop ideas with context and review documents with fresh eyes. EGM is an open-source plugin for AI assistants.

Elephant holds your project context and drafts the specification. Goldfish reviewers examine the draft and referenced source material without the earlier conversation, helping expose unstated assumptions and blind spots. You make the architectural trade-offs and approve the specification before implementing.

repos.name: google-deepmind/mujoco
repos.description: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
repos.readme_excerpt:
MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. It is a general purpose physics engine that aims to facilitate research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, machine learning, and other areas which demand fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment.

This repository is maintained by Google DeepMind.

repos.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
repos.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
repos.readme_excerpt:
Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

Skills encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices that senior engineers use when building software. These ones are packaged so AI agents follow them consistently across every phase of development.

9 slash commands that map to the development lifecycle. Each one activates the right skills automatically.
